kind: static reading of the source and one compiler probe; no model, container, network or external peer

acp.reading: The client advertises no file or terminal capability, so an agent works only with its own tools inside the contained runtime. ACP carries work to a local contained agent; it is not containment and not external delegation.

mcp.reading: The assistant surface inspects, proposes, starts approved work and prepares handovers. No tool approves a plan, records a verdict, sends, merges or adopts.

dependencies.modelSelection: by the agent command and its declared credential names in the plan; the harness names no model
dependencies.identity: an actor string recorded on grants, decisions and Sends; not authenticated
dependencies.memory: none: no agent state persists between sessions beyond the repository and retained evidence

a2a.reading: No A2A client exists and the compiler refuses any external task node. An external result has no route into a graph, and nothing could distinguish it from a locally contained agent.

integration.choice: Delegate one bounded source change to an external A2A agent that returns a patch artifact; apply it to the exact input source in controller storage; verify it afresh in a contained verifier before anything can hold, route or deliver it.

matrix.case: peer completes with a patch artifact
matrix.expected: a candidate owned by the delegation, verified afresh by a following check
refused in preflight; nothing sent; the node stays reserved

matrix.case: agent card differs from the pinned digest
matrix.expected: refused before sending; a changed identity after completion makes the outcome unavailable

matrix.case: peer reports failed, rejected or input/auth required
matrix.expected: a failed outcome with the peer's state, no candidate

matrix.case: peer or operator cancels, or the declared timeout passes
matrix.expected: CancelTask is sent once; outcome canceled; no candidate
the first terminal state is recorded once; repeats change nothing

matrix.case: malformed artifact: missing, several, wrong media type, not a patch, touches protected paths or does not apply
matrix.expected: unavailable with a named reason; no candidate

matrix.case: crash after sending, before the task id is retained

limits: Only JSON-RPC over HTTP(S), no streaming or push notifications.
No peer authentication scheme beyond the pinned card digest and an HTTPS endpoint; a loopback endpoint is accepted only for local fixtures.
An Agent Card and a completion claim grant nothing; only the local verification counts.
